claims.claim_text: The indexed John O Cosgrave is a high-confidence match to commercial artist and book illustrator John O'Hara Cosgrave II (1908-1968).
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier links the index to a 1908-born Army entrant classified as a commercial artist; two independent prewar and institutional sources identify John O'Hara Cosgrave as an illustrator.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier, exact first and last name, matching middle initial, 1908 birth-year field and distinctive commercial-art occupation jointly distinguish the younger illustrator from his namesake uncle.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to 1 June 1943; the newspaper credit is dated 4 April 1940. Neither source establishes an OSS start date.
claims.match_notes: The personnel file remains necessary to confirm the expanded middle name and complete Army-to-OSS chronology. The senior John O'Hara Cosgrave, an editor born in 1866, is not assigned to this record.

claims.temporal_assessment: The 4 April 1940 illustration credit is definitely prewar and predates Army entry in 1943; no source reviewed establishes immediacy before OSS.
claims.match_notes: This is modeled as self-employment, not as employment by a publisher. It is excluded from immediate-affiliation and last-civilian-employer analytics.
